chalisa.do1: Placing on my own head the dust of the lotus feet of father and mother, I bow to Mother Sarasvatī: giver, grant me wisdom and strength.
chalisa.do2: Your glory, boundless and infinite, pervades the whole world. Mother, may you alone now destroy the sin of Rāmasāgara.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to you, Śrī, treasury of all wisdom and strength; victory to the all-knowing, the immortal, the imperishable. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Victory, victory, victory to you who hold the vīṇā in your hand; you always ride a fair swan. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Mother, you bear a four-armed form and are renowned throughout the whole world. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: When thoughts of sin arise in the world, then the light of dharma grows dim. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Then the Mother descends in her own incarnation; she rids the earth of sin and delivers it. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Vālmīki was a killer; the world knows the grace you showed him. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: He composed the story of Śrī Rāma with care and won the title of the first poet. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Kālidāsa became renowned through your gracious glance, Mother. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Tulasīdāsa, Sūradāsa and other learned men, and the many other wise men there have been, ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: had no other support, Mother, than your grace alone. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Show that same grace, Mother Bhavānī, knowing me for your own sorrowful, humble servant. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: A son commits many offences, yet a good mother does not hold them in her mind. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Mother, keep my honour now; I plead with you in many ways. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: I am helpless, and you are my support. Show me grace; victory, victory to you, Mother of the world. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Madhu and Kaiṭabha, who were exceedingly mighty, took up a hand-to-hand fight with Viṣṇu. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: The terrible battle went on for five thousand years, yet Viṣṇu did not turn his face from them. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: At that time the Mother gave her help, and the minds of those wicked ones were turned upside down. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Through that the wicked met their death. Mother, fulfil my wish. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa were renowned, and you slew them in a moment, Mother. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Before so mighty a sinner as Raktabīja, the hearts of gods and sages and the whole earth trembled. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: You cut off his head like the stem of a plantain. Again and again I pray to you, Mother of the world. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Śumbha and Niśumbha were famed throughout the world, and you, Mother, slew them in a moment. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: You went and turned the mind of Bharata's mother, and caused Śrī Rāma to be exiled to the forest. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: In this way you accomplished the slaying of Rāvaṇa, and gave happiness to gods, men and sages, to all. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Who is able to sing your fame and virtues? The Vedas have called you without beginning and without end. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Viṣṇu, Rudra and Brahmā cannot kill those whose protector you are. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Raktadantikā and Śatākṣī: your names are boundless, devourer of demons. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: You did an arduous deed on earth, and the whole world took up your name Durgā. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Mother, you are the slayer of the demon Durga (Durgama) and the others; giver of joy, show grace whenever trouble comes. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: When an angry king seeks to kill someone, when lions close in around one in the forest, ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: when the ship breaks up in mid-ocean, in a great storm, with no one at hand, ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: in trouble from ghosts and spirits or in sorrow, when one is poor or in distress, ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: chanting the name brings all to good; let no one have any doubt of this. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Brother, those who are anxious for want of a son should leave everything else and worship this Mother, ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: and recite this Chālīsā daily; a handsome son, a master of virtues, will be born to them. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: One who offers incense and the like, and food offerings, surely becomes free of distress. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Those who always worship the Mother with devotion: no affliction comes near them. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: If a prisoner recites it a hundred times, the whole noose of his captivity falls away. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Bhavānī, to end Rāmasāgara's troubles, show grace, knowing him for your own servant. ॥39॥
chalisa.do3: Mother, your radiance is the sun, and my form is darkness. Save me from drowning; may I not fall into the well of worldly existence.
chalisa.do4: Give me strength, wisdom and learning; hear me, Mother Sarasvatī. To lowly Rāmasāgara, may you alone give refuge.
